## Profile

Sergey Rubanov works on AI agent infrastructure, the web platform, developer tools, observability, and open source. He contributes to TC39 and W3C standards for JavaScript, browser interoperability, and web APIs.

## Core Skills

- AI / agent systems: agent orchestration, tool execution, evaluation harnesses, provider routing, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, llama.cpp, MCP/ACP
- Web platform / standards: ECMA-262, ECMA-402, TC39, W3C, Test262, WebAssembly, JavaScriptCore, WebKit, browser/WebView runtimes
- Languages: TypeScript, Go, C++, Zig, Coq/Rocq
- Platform / observability: OpenTelemetry, traces/metrics/logs, Prometheus, Grafana, OTel Collector, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, GCP, Cloudflare

## Projects

### Hecate

Local-first AI workspace and runtime for chats, model providers, project-scoped work, and supervised coding agents.

- Capabilities: OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility; native and ACP agent sessions; approvals and diff review; project context and memory; usage reporting and OpenTelemetry.
- Website: https://hecate.sh
- Source: https://github.com/hecatehq/hecate

### Cynic

Strict-only ECMAScript and WebAssembly engine written from scratch in Zig, with hardened realms and host-controlled code generation.

- Capabilities: strict semantics without Annex B; frozen primordials and built-in `harden()`; opt-in `eval`; WebAssembly support; Test262 and Wasm conformance suites.
- Website: https://sergey.works/cynic
- Source: https://github.com/chicoxyzzy/cynic

### Pragmatist

Tool that lets agents find and prove bugs in ECMAScript specifications, TypeScript, JavaScript engines, and WebAssembly runtimes.

- Capabilities: pinned specification data; Coq/Rocq mechanization; TypeScript AST and library diffs; cross-runtime differential runs; patch scaffolding; deterministic replay of every finding.
- Status: coming soon
- Stack: TypeScript, Coq/Rocq, ECMA-262, WebAssembly, tsgo, Zod

### TC39 MCP

MCP server that gives agents structured, reproducible access to ECMA-262 and ECMA-402 instead of a multi-megabyte HTML document.

- Capabilities: clause and AOID search; bidirectional cross-spec references; edition diffs and git history; Test262 and proposal lookup; SHA-pinned responses; local stdio and hosted HTTP.
- Website: https://mcp.xyzzylabs.ai/tc39/
- Source: https://github.com/xyzzylabs/tc39-mcp

### WASM MCP

Read-only MCP server for the WebAssembly Core, JavaScript, and Web APIs, with instruction-level and clause-level lookup.

- Capabilities: opcode, stack signature, and trap metadata; validation and execution references; full-text spec search; proposal index; SHA-pinned deterministic responses; local stdio and hosted HTTP.
- Website: https://mcp.xyzzylabs.ai/wasm/
